messages:
todd: Quick heads-up: changelog cutoff for devex SDKs/docs/sampleapps is ~18h from now (tomorrow 10:00 UTC). Need final owner sign-offs. Please state status and blockers.

mike: SDK: main PR merged (GH #786). Packaging step failing on mac-arm build, investigating. No publish yet. CC @maria for final review before publish.

maria: On it — will try to review tonight. Only skimmed, saw a minor typing error in client.ts. I'll comment.

devex-ci-bot: Build #786-17: mac-arm failed: prebuild step (log truncated) ...

mike: thanks. local workaround: `npm run build:all && npm pack` — but CI still flakes. thinking it's node 20 vs 18 on mac runner.

elaine: Docs freeze: I've frozen the docs tree for the SDK reference branch at 6h before cutoff. Need sample app snippets updated for the client API (method rename). If sampleapps don't update, we'll need a small note in changelog.

jon: sample-apps: I can update the snippets tonight, but I need the exact method names. @mike can you paste the new usage snippet?

mike: new usage: ```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({apiKey});
await client.generate({prompt: 'hi'});
``` old was `client.text.generate`

jon: got it. I'll do quick PR to sample-apps and link it here.

sara: QA: smoke tests scheduled in 2 runs — can run final smoke after packages published. Also need a staging key from eng-infra to test end-to-end (embeddings endpoint). @todd who's owning infra creds?

todd: @jon can you grab the staging key? eng-infra asked owner to request via #eng-infra. If blocked we can use a temporary token.

jon: I'll request now.

maria: reviewed GH #786 — left one small comment about error typing. If I approve, can we still do a manual publish? @mike

mike: yes, once CI green and Maria approves I'll do `npm publish --tag rc` then push a release candidate tag.

devex-ci-bot: Build #786-18: mac-arm passed (rerun).

mike: ok publishing in ~15m.

jon: sample-apps PR: 1758503120 — updated snippets, added a changelog note. Please review quickly.

elaine: thanks @jon — I pulled the snippet and updated the docs. Leaving a placeholder in changelog: 'client API rename — see sample app for new usage'

todd: Final checklist: SDK publish (mike) ✅ after CI + review, docs updated (elaine) ✅, sample apps PR (jon) ✅, QA run (sara) waiting on staging key. Maria please approve when ready. I'll cut the changelog at 10:00 UTC tomorrow.

sara: requested staging key from #eng-infra. ETA 1-2h.

maria: approving now. :thumbsup:

todd: thanks all. if anything slips ping me directly. :shipit:
